alkylation reagent: followed by alkylation with iodoacetamide (11 mM)
alkylation concentration: followed by alkylation with iodoacetamide (11 mM)
cleavage agent: The alkylated proteins were then digested with trypsin
enrichment method: mono-, double-, and tri-methylated resin antibody beads
incubated with mono-, double-, and tri-methylated resin antibody beads at 4 °C to enrich the methylated peptides
fractionation method: High pH reverse-phase HPLC with a C 18 column (5 μm particles, 10 mm i.d., 250 mm in length) was used to fractionate the tryptic peptides
instrument: MS/MS analysis in a Q Exactive Plus (Thermo)
ionization type: The eluted peptides were subjected to nanospray ionization
labeling: The eluted peptides were subjected to nanospray ionization and then MS/MS analysis in a Q Exactive Plus (Thermo)
precursor tolerance: The mass tolerance allowed for precursor ions in the first search and the main research were 20 ppm and 5 ppm, respectively.
fragment tolerance: The mass tolerance allowed for fragment ions was 0.02 Da.
ptm: oxidation on Met (variable); carbamidomethyl on Cys (fixed)
The oxidation on Met and carbamidomethyl on Cys were specified as variable modification and fixed modification, respectively.
reduction reagent: The extracted proteins were reduced with dithiothreitol (5 mM)
reduction concentration: The extracted proteins were reduced with dithiothreitol (5 mM)
